_comment: The region sets the picker offers, in order. Each `file` is resolved next to
this manifest. `attribution` is displayed under the region list and must be
filled in for any set whose license requires it (IGRAC's CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
does); null means nothing is shown.
Every set is expected in the app's own schema: one feature per region, with
`n` (name) and `id` (unique within the set) properties, in WGS84. Converting
and simplifying a published dataset into that shape belongs in data/, not in

sets.label: Global Aquifers
sets.attribution: Original source unrecorded; gaps filled from Large Aquifer Systems of the World, WHYMAP (BGR/UNESCO) and Transboundary Aquifers of the World 2025 (UNESCO-IHP / IGRAC, CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO). Added features carry a src property.
